Not the same thing as KNOWN_STOPPAGES and friends in builders/extract.py.
Those are VETTED: a value there has been read, understood, and given prose
somewhere. This file is ACKNOWLEDGED: we have seen it, it cannot change any
number, and rendering it verbatim is more honest than inventing a label --
which is what src/lib/layers/whistle.js already says about its own table.
WHY IT HAS TO EXIST AT ALL. derive.py forgives these and records them in
index.json under `noted`, and for a long time that was the whole story: 23
values were being forgiven on every run and the workflow printed a count.
A record nobody is alerted by is the same gap an unnamed gameType sat in.
So the alarm is on DRIFT, not on the count. Twenty-three known values are
not news; a twenty-fourth is. derive.py exits 2 when `noted` holds anything
absent from this file -- AFTER PUBLISHING, because none of this can reach a
number and withholding the archive over a label is the mistake the 73 refused
games already were.
⛔⛔⛔ AND FOR SIX DAYS THAT LAST PARAGRAPH WAS FALSE OF THE PIPELINE, 2026-09-25.
It was true of derive.py, which writes everything before it alarms. It was not
true of ingest.yml, which ran derive as an ordinary step -- so a non-zero exit
halted the job and the sync never ran. Three new penalty descriptors stopped
the site at `dataThrough 2026-09-23` for five consecutive runs and 31 hours: a
display label withholding real hockey, which is the exact mistake this
paragraph names. It had happened three times before, on 09-19, 09-21 and 09-23,
and each time somebody added the word and moved on.
The exit code now carries the severity instead of this paragraph: 2 means
published-and-unnamed, 1 means the output cannot be trusted. The workflows read
it and alarm AFTER the sync, and test/workflows.test.js compares the two step
positions -- because a comment cannot fail, which is the whole reason this
sentence was wrong for six days while three people read it.
TO ADD ONE: look at it first. If it deserves prose it belongs in extract.py
and whistle.js instead, and this file is where it goes only once you have
